---
title: Your first analysis
---

Run a complete pathway-first example before preparing your own files. The
maintained script uses 80 synthetic samples, two bundled signatures, GLM and one
requested Response endpoint. No AI service or API key is needed. The data are synthetic.

## Locate the example

```r
library(IOBRcausal)
script <- system.file("examples", "pathway_first_minimal.R", package = "IOBRcausal")
stopifnot(nzchar(script), file.exists(script))
rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"),
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Rscript.exe" else "Rscript")
Sys.setenv(IOBRCAUSAL_EXAMPLE_OUTPUT = file.path(path.expand("~"), "iobrcausal-demo"))
```

You can also [download the same English script](assets/downloads/pathway_first_minimal.R).
It uses the public `iobrcausal()` entry for the complete workflow.

## Preview, then run

```r
# Preview the inputs and planned stages.
system2(rscript, shQuote(script))

# Execute the synthetic example when you are ready.
system2(rscript, c(shQuote(script), "--run"))
```

The preview does not fit models. The executed script prints the actual delivery
directory inside `~/iobrcausal-demo` (your home folder). Open that printed path
to find the results. If several package libraries exist, use the same R installation and
check the engine path rather than assuming the subprocess loaded your latest package.

## Open the result

Open `README.md` inside the delivery directory printed by the script. Follow its
links to validation, the endpoint report, full statistics and figures. Read the
actual stage statuses; an empty candidate sheet can be a valid outcome.

| What to inspect | What it tells you |
| --- | --- |
| Requested endpoint | Only Response was requested in this example |
| Workflow stages | Which steps completed, were empty, skipped or failed |
| Formal estimate table | Effect scale, uncertainty, method and support |
| Pathway-gene mapping | Which original members connect each pathway to genes |
| Full audit tables | Rows hidden from a short display, including failures |

To adapt this to your files, continue with [data preparation](data-preparation.qmd)
and the [pathway-first workflow](workflows/pathway-first.qmd).
To inspect an existing delivery, use [saved results](workflows/saved-results.qmd).
